title: doc-kit kinds of spaces (standard/spaces.json)
description: One profile per audience: what the kit does differently for the pages of a space of that kind (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1a).

retired.description: Ids of the spaces of an earlier kit (0.3: business, takeover): a project that still declares one is told to run doc-kit upgrade.

icon.description: Default icon of the space, from the kit's set.

board.description: Its home shows the Product board (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.8b): the backlog of the feature sheets.

depth.description: The audit measures the depth of its feature sheets (standard/maturity.md: featureSheets, scenarios, behaviourDepth); with spaces declared, n/a when none is of such a kind.

noCode.description: Its pages are read without the code: a business page that cites a file is reported (business.technical).

proofs.description: Its written pages are expected to carry file:line proofs (audit: proofs4); it is then the takeover space, outside written2.

glossaryTechnical.description: Its readers see the technical correspondence of the glossary terms (§6.8).

takeoverItems.description: The required takeover pages (standard/maturity.md) that live in a space of this kind (audit: takeover4).

preferTypes.description: The usual page types of the space, preferred when the audit guesses the type of an untyped page.
